jess: Heads up — SI partner Paxion reporting missing usage for a subset of customers. They say webhooks went out but our ledger shows gaps. Can we sync? TL;DR: possible claim TTL vs partner retry window mismatch.

sam: On it. Any reproducible example payloads we can look at?

jess: They sent one, pasted below. @kevin can you check our ingest TTL vs their retry semantics? Also linked their webhook spec: https://paxion.example.com/webhooks (partner doc).

oliver: pasted payload from partner: ```json
{
  "customer_id": "cust_42",
  "usage_units": 1200,
  "event_time": "2026-03-21T14:22:30Z",
  "sequence": 987654321,
  "reported_at": 1712345678,
  "ttl_seconds": 21600,
  "signature": "sha256=..."
}
```

kevin: Looking: they set ttl_seconds=21600 (6h) and they retry up to 6h. Our ingest pipeline default marketplace TTL is 3600 (1h) for dedupe/windowing. That explains drops — events arriving after 1h get dropped before ledger mapping.

nina: Product question: when an event is dropped does billing surface an undercount or do we auto-generate credits? We should decide mitigation for affected customers (~120 accounts mentioned).

sam: Currently we drop out-of-window events; we do have a replay/backfill path if partner replays with original signature and sequence. Two options: accept longer TTL for this vendor, or ask partner to shorten retry.

oliver: From Paxion side: our retry strategy is exponential backoff up to 6h because their batching can delay delivery. We can shorten window but prefer service-side acceptance.

kevin: Proposal: 1) temporary canary: extend ingest TTL to 8h for vendor_id = paxion (namespace) 2) add a soft-accept flag so we accept late events but mark them as "replayed" in metadata 3) require Paxion to add header `X-Partner-Retry: yes` so we can opt-in. Need infra/cost approval.

maria: Extending dedupe window to 8h increases state but not huge — estimate +5% memory in dedupe service for the marketplace partition. Canary is wise. Also need to check retention of KV cache for sequences.

sam: Runbook sketch: 1) add vendor-specific TTL override in marketplace-ingest config, 2) create canary route for vendor paxion in prod with 1% traffic, 3) monitor dedupe memory and duplicate rate, 4) if green, roll to 100% for this vendor. I'll draft PR and runbook. Commands: ```bash
# enable canary
./infractl set-ttl --env prod --vendor paxion --ttl 28800
# create header rule
./ingestctl add-header-rule --vendor paxion --header X-Partner-Retry
```

jess: Who will own partner comms? We should time announcement with canary start and offer to replay missed events.

oliver: I'll coordinate with Paxion SRE; they'll add the header and trigger a replay once we confirm acceptance. ETA: tomorrow 10am PT.

nina: Also: list impacted customers and propose credits. @lisa from finance — can you prepare credit thresholds if ledger drop > 1% of monthly usage?

lisa: Please add a CSV with account IDs and estimated missing usage volumes. Finance will fast-track credits if material.

sam: I created a gist for the runbook and replay checklist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/paxion-replay-runbook — includes signature verification steps and sequence remap notes.

kevin: I'll own the canary deploy at 03:00 UTC. Sam, please tag me in the PR and add smoke tests for duplicate detection.

jess: Great. I'll open a short incident ticket to track impacts and decisions. If billing run is affected we'll escalate. Marking severity P2 for now. :thumbsup:

integration-bot: New ticket created: #PAX-4532 — paxion late-retry ingest investigation (link: https://redwood.app/tickets/PAX-4532)
